items.title: Portico Row
items.description: Cool-white institutional gravitas for firms whose only product is credibility. Brand navy is structure (header bands, engraved hairline rules, serif wordmark) and never decorates content panels; Source Serif 4 display over a 19px Source Sans 3 body floor; square 0-2px corners with hairlines instead of shadows; airy 72-120px bands; numbered substance rows with figure and date; attorney cards with credential lines; a mandatory compliance footer on every page.
